name: LISA: The Joyful Vita
author: Pinol0
description:
Unofficial native port of LISA: The Joyful (Legacy Edition, RPG Maker VX Ace) to the PS Vita, the same engine as LISA: The Painful Vita. Experimental: the game has been completed on hardware.

- Screen options: 1:1, Original, Stretch and real widescreen (Wide)
- The 10 Steam achievements, unlocked on the Vita
- Combo keys on the face buttons and the right stick

Very long sessions can still run out of memory, save often. No game files are included: copy Data, Graphics, Audio and Fonts from your own copy to ux0:data/lisa_joyful/ (extract Game.rgss3a first). Runs well at the default 333 MHz; heavy maps drop a little more there, and the PSVshell overclock at 500 MHz smooths them out.
requirements: Your own copy of LISA: The Joyful, Legacy Edition (RPG Maker VX Ace, not the Unity Definitive Edition). Game files in ux0:data/lisa_joyful/. Overclock optional (500 MHz smooths the heaviest maps).
